meta.based_on: Schwerer Panzerspähwagen (5 cm) Sd.Kfz. 234/2 'Puma', 8x8, with the 5 cm KwK 39/1 L/60
meta.notes: Side profile and axle positions traced from the IWM broadside photograph (public domain, Wikimedia Commons). Tatra 103 V12 diesel 210 hp; six gears forward and six reverse (a second driver at the rear), eight-wheel drive and eight-wheel steering (front pair one way, rear pair the other). Gear ratios are chosen to match the published 90 km/h; interior layout is an estimate.
